## v1 definition and normal-UI capability evidence

The App Studio-generated widget exposes **only normal visible App UI**: a readable JSON view, **Dirty A v1**, and **Clean B v1 no-op** buttons. Its visible generated implementation subscribes to the App Studio-provided update mechanism and emits normal App action events. The test process did not directly invoke or manipulate that integration; it was inspected only as code generated by the product’s own visible App Studio workflow.

| v1 field / shape | Seed definition saved in App Studio | UI read path | Planned dirty-A mutation | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---:|
| Primitive no-ID array | `primitiveNoId:["a","b","c"]` | Pretty JSON inspector | middle element to `"A-local"` | **DISCOVERED_ONLY** |
| Object no-ID array | `objectsNoId:[{"name":"a"},{"name":"b"}]` | Pretty JSON inspector | second object to `{"name":"B-local"}` | **DISCOVERED_ONLY** |
| Duplicate-ID object array | `duplicateId:[{"id":"x","v":1},{"id":"x","v":2}]` | Pretty JSON inspector | v5-only candidate | **DISCOVERED_ONLY** |
| Scalar | `count:1` | Pretty JSON inspector | `9` | **DISCOVERED_ONLY** |
| Object | `profile:{a:1,b:2}` | Pretty JSON inspector | none in v1 | **DISCOVERED_ONLY** |
| Null | `nullable:null` | Pretty JSON inspector | v4-only candidate | **DISCOVERED_ONLY** |
